add_subscriber_tag_by_name.description: Tag one contact. Manychat creates the tag on the account first if it does not have it, so this does not need 'Create tag' in front of it.
add_subscriber_tag_by_name.display_str_template: Add a tag to a Manychat contact.
add_subscriber_tag_by_name.name: add_subscriber_tag_by_name

parameters.description: The contact to act on. Manychat shows the id on a contact card under Contacts, and every contact action here returns it as 'id'. A contact exists only once someone has messaged the bot - this integration cannot create one. Contacts are not offered as a list because an account has as many as it has ever talked to - use 'Find contacts by name' or 'Find contact by email or phone' to get one.
parameters.name: subscriber_id

parameters.description: The tag's name, as it appears in Manychat under Settings > Tags. Pick one from the list, or type a name - including one an earlier step in this workflow created, which the list will not have yet.
parameters.name: tag_name

added.description: Always true - Manychat reported no error

create_bot_field.description: Define a new account-wide variable the bot can read, optionally with a starting value. As with a contact field, the type is fixed at creation.
create_bot_field.display_str_template: Create a bot field in Manychat.
create_bot_field.name: create_bot_field

parameters.description: What to call the bot field.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: What the field holds. This is fixed when the field is created and decides what its value has to look like: a date field takes 2026-09-14, a date-and-time field takes a full timestamp.
parameters.name: field_type

parameters.description: An optional note about what the field is for, shown beside it in Manychat.
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: An optional first value. It must suit the type chosen above; leave it empty to create the field unset.
parameters.name: value

bot_field.description: The bot field that was created

value.description: The field's current value: text, a number, true/false, a 'YYYY-MM-DD' date or a date and time, depending on the field's type

create_custom_field.description: Define a new field that every contact can hold a value for. The type is fixed at creation and decides what values the field accepts afterwards, so pick it deliberately: Manychat offers no way to change it later.
create_custom_field.display_str_template: Create a contact field in Manychat.
create_custom_field.name: create_custom_field

parameters.description: What to call the field. Manychat calls this the caption when the field is created and the name everywhere afterwards.
parameters.name: caption

parameters.description: What the field holds. This is fixed when the field is created and decides what its value has to look like: a date field takes 2026-09-14, a date-and-time field takes a full timestamp.
parameters.name: field_type

parameters.description: An optional note about what the field is for, shown beside it in Manychat.
parameters.name: description

custom_field.description: The contact field that was created

create_tag.description: Add a tag to the account so contacts can be segmented by it. Returns the new tag with the id every other tag action uses. Tagging a contact does not need this first: 'Add tag to contact' creates the tag if the account does not have it.
create_tag.name: create_tag

parameters.description: What to call the tag. This is what appears in Manychat under Settings > Tags.
parameters.name: name

delete_tag.description: Delete a tag from the whole account. Manychat also strips it from every contact carrying it, and this cannot be undone. To untag one contact and leave the tag alone, use 'Remove tag from contact' instead.
delete_tag.display_str_template: Delete a tag from the Manychat account.
delete_tag.name: delete_tag

parameters.description: The tag to delete, picked from the account's tags. A tag id from an earlier step can be typed in instead.
parameters.name: tag_id

deleted.description: Always true - Manychat reported no error

find_subscriber_by_email_or_phone.description: Look one contact up by their email address or their phone number - an exact match, not a search. Set one of the two, not both. Nothing matching is an answer rather than a failure: 'found' comes back false and the workflow can branch on it.
find_subscriber_by_email_or_phone.display_name: Find contact by email or phone
find_subscriber_by_email_or_phone.display_str_template: Find a Manychat contact by email or phone.
find_subscriber_by_email_or_phone.name: find_subscriber_by_email_or_phone

parameters.description: The contact's email address. Leave empty if searching by phone number.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: The contact's phone number. Leave empty if searching by email address.
parameters.name: phone

subscriber.description: The contact, or empty when none matched

value.description: This contact's value for the field

find_subscribers_by_name.description: Search the account's contacts by full name. Manychat caps this at 100 results and offers no second page, so a search that hits the cap is reported as such rather than pretending to be complete. For an exact match, use 'Find contact by email or phone'.
find_subscribers_by_name.name: find_subscribers_by_name

parameters.description: The name to search for. Manychat matches against a contact's full name, so 'Ada Lovelace' rather than 'Ada'.
parameters.name: name

limit_reached.description: True when the cap was hit, meaning matches were dropped

result_limit.description: The most Manychat will return from this search (100)

value.description: This contact's value for the field

get_page_info.description: The Manychat account this connection reaches: its name, username, category, avatar, timezone and whether it is on a Pro plan. The cheapest way to confirm a connection is alive, and the way to tell which of several Manychat accounts a workflow is pointed at - an API key belongs to exactly one.
get_page_info.display_str_template: Get the connected Manychat account's details.
get_page_info.name: get_page_info

get_subscriber.description: One contact in full: names, channel handles and opt-ins for Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, SMS and email, when they last interacted, every tag they carry and every contact field's value.
get_subscriber.name: get_subscriber

parameters.description: The contact to act on. Manychat shows the id on a contact card under Contacts, and every contact action here returns it as 'id'. A contact exists only once someone has messaged the bot - this integration cannot create one. Contacts are not offered as a list because an account has as many as it has ever talked to - use 'Find contacts by name' or 'Find contact by email or phone' to get one.
parameters.name: subscriber_id

value.description: This contact's value for the field

list_bot_fields.description: Every bot field on the account, with its current value. A bot field is one value for the whole bot - today's promo code, whether the shop is open - unlike a contact field, which holds a value per contact.
list_bot_fields.display_str_template: List the Manychat account's bot fields.

bot_fields.description: Whether the shop is taking orders
bot_fields.name: Shop open

list_bot_fields.name: list_bot_fields

bot_fields.description: Every bot field on the account, with its current value

value.description: The field's current value: text, a number, true/false, a 'YYYY-MM-DD' date or a date and time, depending on the field's type

count.description: How many bot fields the account has

list_custom_fields.description: Every contact field defined on the account, with its type. A contact field holds a different value for each contact - 'Favourite roast', 'Last order date'. For the bot's own account-wide variables, use 'List bot fields'.
list_custom_fields.display_str_template: List the Manychat account's contact fields.
list_custom_fields.name: list_custom_fields

count.description: How many contact fields the account has

custom_fields.description: Every contact field on the account

list_flows.description: Every automation built in this Manychat account, with the folders they are filed in. The 'ns' of an automation is the only identifier 'Send automation' accepts, and this is where it comes from.
list_flows.name: list_flows

count.description: How many automations the account has

flows.description: Every automation, each with the 'ns' that names it

folder_count.description: How many folders they are filed in

folders.description: The folders the automations are filed in

list_tags.description: Every tag on the account, with the id each one is deleted by. Manychat returns the whole list in one call - there is no page two - so the count is the account's total.
list_tags.display_str_template: List every tag on the Manychat account.
list_tags.name: list_tags

count.description: How many tags the account has

remove_subscriber_tag_by_name.description: Take a tag off one contact. The tag itself stays on the account and every other contact keeps it - 'Delete tag' is the one that removes it everywhere.
remove_subscriber_tag_by_name.display_str_template: Remove a tag from a Manychat contact.
remove_subscriber_tag_by_name.name: remove_subscriber_tag_by_name

parameters.description: The contact to act on. Manychat shows the id on a contact card under Contacts, and every contact action here returns it as 'id'. send_flow.description: Start one of the account's automations for a contact. This is how a workflow messages someone through Manychat: the automation was built in Manychat, so Manychat applies its own sending rules and channel choice to it. Manychat allows 100 sends per contact per hour.
send_flow.display_str_template: Send a Manychat automation to a contact.
send_flow.name: send_flow

parameters.description: The contact to act on. Manychat shows the id on a contact card under Contacts, and every contact action here returns it as 'id'. A contact exists only once someone has messaged the bot - this integration cannot create one. Contacts are not offered as a list because an account has as many as it has ever talked to - use 'Find contacts by name' or 'Find contact by email or phone' to get one.
parameters.name: subscriber_id

parameters.description: The automation to send, picked from the account's automations. Nothing here creates one, so the list is complete - build the automation in Manychat first if it is not there.
parameters.name: flow_ns

sent.description: Always true - Manychat reported no error

subscriber_id.description: The contact it was sent to

set_bot_field.description: Change an account-wide bot field's value, choosing the field from a list. Use 'Set bot field by name' instead when the field is named by an earlier step rather than picked here.
set_bot_field.display_str_template: Set a Manychat bot field's value.
set_bot_field.name: set_bot_field

parameters.description: The bot field to set, picked from the account's fields. A field id from an earlier step can be typed in instead.
parameters.name: field_id

parameters.description: The value to store. Text, a number or true/false is stored as it stands; a date or date-and-time carried over from an earlier step is converted to the format Manychat expects. It must suit the field's type - Manychat refuses a word in a number field.
parameters.name: field_value

field_id.description: The bot field that was set

field_value.description: The value as it was sent to Manychat

updated.description: Always true - Manychat reported no error

set_bot_field_by_name.display_str_template: Set a Manychat bot field's value by name.
set_bot_field_by_name.name: set_bot_field_by_name

parameters.description: The bot field's name. Pick one from the list, or type a name - including one an earlier step in this workflow created, which the list will not have yet.
parameters.name: field_name

parameters.description: The value to store. Text, a number or true/false is stored as it stands; a date or date-and-time carried over from an earlier step is converted to the format Manychat expects. It must suit the field's type - Manychat refuses a word in a number field.
parameters.name: field_value

field_name.description: The bot field that was set

field_value.description: The value as it was sent to Manychat

The field must already exist on the account; 'Create contact field' adds one. Manychat matches the field name without regard to case.
set_subscriber_custom_field_by_name.display_str_template: Set a contact field on a Manychat contact.

field_name.description: The contact field that was set

update_subscriber.description: Change a contact's first name, last name or gender. Only the fields filled in here are sent; the rest are left alone. Email, phone and opt-ins are not offered: Manychat treats writing them onto a contact as an import, which needs an account permission ('Import Contacts') that Manychat support grants by hand and never during a trial.
update_subscriber.name: update_subscriber

parameters.description: The contact to act on. Manychat shows the id on a contact card under Contacts, and every contact action here returns it as 'id'. A contact exists only once someone has messaged the bot - this integration cannot create one. Contacts are not offered as a list because an account has as many as it has ever talked to - use 'Find contacts by name' or 'Find contact by email or phone' to get one.
parameters.name: subscriber_id

parameters.description: Leave empty to keep the current first name.
parameters.name: first_name

parameters.description: Leave empty to keep the current last name.
parameters.name: last_name

parameters.description: Free text. Manychat documents no list of accepted values, so whatever is sent is what is stored. Leave empty to keep the current value.
parameters.name: gender

value.description: This contact's value for the field

description: Work with the contacts in a Manychat account across Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS and email: find one by name, email or phone, update their name, tag them, set or clear their fields, read and set the bot's own fields, and send a contact an automation built in Manychat.
